Hi Alex —

Thanks again for interviewing for the Senior Backend Engineer role. Attached is the coding exercise we use to evaluate systems design and inference-serving tradeoffs. The ask is intentionally time-boxed: 4 hours of focused work, delivered as a short write-up and a runnable example (Docker or a short script).

Quick logistics: 
- Deadline: Friday, May 7, 11:59pm PT (we're keeping a single cutoff to simplify scheduling).
- What to submit: README.md with approach, a small runnable artifact, and any test expectations. A single ZIP or link to a Git repo is fine.
- Submission: reply to this thread with the artifact or a link to a private repo.
- Review: we'll schedule a 60-minute asynchronous reviewer panel to go over your submission; expect approx. two reviewers and one moderator.

If you need a short extension due to timing constraints, tell us by EOD Wednesday so we can reallocate reviewers. Otherwise, assume the deadline above.
